sonnet.problem: This choice card asks about David's answer in verses 2-5 before any of those verses have been told. It jumps ahead of the passage, and the baker can only guess because the card before it gives no context for a reasoned pick.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.

sonnet.problem: Card 6 already asked the baker about "does no harm to his neighbor." Card 7 repeats that line in its question and asks only who the three lines are about, which adds no new fact and is easy to answer from the question itself.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
